identity.summary: Astra Pro 2bc5:0403 depth/IR + 2bc5:0501 RGB; isolated Stage29 runtime

modes: Infrared 640x480 30 fps native 8-bit intensity (mono8); 320x240 is advertised but not served by this camera (fw 5.8.22)
CameraInfo fallback is NOT calibrated. XYZ PointCloud2 (/astra/points) only with a VALIDATED calibration file; RGB registration DISABLED.
Explicit Start required; max60s, viewer lease4s; CPU75 / RAM80 / temperature70C

depth.note: 60-second Dashboard session verified on 21 Oct 2026 (607 frames).

concurrent.note: Worked in the isolated Stage 29 test; not yet run through the Dashboard.

ir.note: Infrared 640x480 at 30 fps verified for a full 60-second session on 21 Oct 2026 (1,624 frames, 29.7 fps). This camera never sends the 320x240 infrared mode.

ir_depth.note: Infrared and depth together; not yet tested on this camera. A CPU stop would not prove the mode unsupported.

rgb_ir.note: Colour and infrared together; not yet tested on this camera. Do not assume the camera supports it.

depth_cloud.note: 3D point cloud stays off until the camera calibration is validated (factory calibration reads as NaN).
